content.text: Summary: Read T-3008, listed pods in `analytics`, and found clickhoug-2's event shows the Corvane CSI driver's MountDevice is being rejected by storage array `cv-array-02` with `CVN-4127: host group hg-k8s-prod reached max LUN mappings (512)`. Since this is an external SAN limit requiring storage-admin action (not a Kubernetes fix), I escalated the ticket to the storage team.
